plain_text:
BSD Policy & Governance Committee Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Champlain Elementary School - Library 800 Pine Street 
Commissioners Present: Jeff Wick, Chair, Lucia Campriello, Polly Vanderputten 
Staff Present: BSD HR Specialist Kathy Finck, Executive Director of Finance Nate Lavery 
Additional Attendees: BSD Board Chair Claire Wool, Commissioner Melissa Zygmant 
 
 
1. Opening  
1.1 Call meeting to order 
6:15pm  
1.2 Suspend Robert's Rules 
 
2. Public Comment 
None 
 
3. Discussion  
3.1 A1 
Consider a moratorium of 18 months to “turn off” the Google Gemini chatbot. As of 
November 3, 2026 Google has stated that if a school district “turns off” Gemini, then the 
Google search function will also be disabled. Much discussion followed of present 
practices, including issuing 
Chromebooks to students, liability if misused by a student, what is presently blocked by 
Go Guardian, and AOE guidance. The committee will discuss this issue with the Board. An 
extensive list of questions and input from many sectors is needed. The committee will 
review again at next meeting along with the Procedures that are now in place and any 
proposed policy language. 
  
   
3.2 Review plan of work for 26-27: policies to update/review and old policies to sunset 
Kathy shared the present list of approved, required policies and their status. She also 
shared the list of 22 old policies that need to be addressed – either updated, or sunsetted.  
3.3 Review C10 Response to Harassment, Hazing and Bullying of Students 
The 9/4/26 AOE Model Policy was discussed; further discussion is warranted about the 
BSD additions that may be included. It is understood that the AOE model policy becomes 
effective 12/15/26.
